seo.title: Thibaut Valez - Product consulting
seo.description: I turn ideas into products that matter. Product management driven by value, change management that brings teams along. From vision to launch.

hero.title: I turn ideas into
hero.lead: Three levers to align: value, execution, team buy-in. That's where a product takes off.

offers.o1_lead: Product performance, driven by business value.
offers.o1_description: I prioritise on the value / complexity match - WSJF in SAFe -, not on gut feel. From vision and discovery through to launch. Every trade-off becomes concrete: what we build, what we cut, in what order.
offers.o2_lead: Bring teams along, don't impose on them.
offers.o2_description: Managing and coordinating cross-functional teams. I own the narrative with leadership so that the top and the ground move in the same direction - and the change holds after I leave.
offers.o2_conviction: One conviction drives the way I work: as AI and automation reshape jobs, the challenge stops being purely technical and turns human. In tech, change is constant, and it will only accelerate. Rather than fighting the wind, I'd rather catch the current: steering your course instead of enduring it. A change that works is a change that gets adopted.

approach.claim_a: A strategy that doesn't ship is just a slide.
approach.claim_b: Shipping the wrong priority is just busywork.
approach.lead: My method comes down to one idea: make trade-offs concrete. I prioritise by personas and by calculated business value, then I track the outcome - estimated versus actual performance, ROI and adoption.
approach.honesty: Some features miss the target I'd calculated. The result stays measurable, and it's a step toward the next one. I'll take that over a generic ROI nobody ever checks.

facts.a_detail: Several years as an engineer. I design and I build what I design.
facts.b_detail: Cross-functional teams, up to eight people managed directly.
facts.c_detail: Run in parallel inside a large regulated banking group.
facts.d_detail: Cross-country team collaboration and sync across EMEA, Asia and the US.
facts.certifs_list: Certified Scrum Product Owner · Certified Scrum Master · SAFe Practitioner

missions.title: Selected
missions.m1_description: Leasing platform. I structured delivery and brought the product team along, from vision to execution. We ship faster, and we hit the dates.
missions.m2_description: Coordinating seven squads at once inside a large regulated banking group. A shared delivery framework, without breaking each team's autonomy.
missions.m3_description: As proxy PO, prioritising with WSJF. Pilot launched then validated, before an international rollout across five countries and three continents.
missions.m4_description: SaaS built from scratch. The market didn't follow. What I took from it: challenge the business assumptions far earlier, before the first line of code. That's what sharpens my discovery today.

labs.lead: I don't just advise: I design, I build, I ship. Two labs to stay at the state of the art and prove it. They are not offers.
labs.l1_description: Designed and built from scratch. An AI product for residential property managers. My way of keeping my hands in AI in real conditions, not in a slide.
labs.l2_description: Leasing backed by crypto assets. A risk and compliance layer on top of an on-chain engine, within the MiCA framework. Where regulated finance meets the blockchain.

final.title: Let's talk about your
final.lead: A 30-minute call to understand where you stand and see if I can help. No strings attached.
